accepted_state: Initial eight-area capability expansion is complete.
Default operating phase is hardening, consolidation, outcome validation, and gap-oriented learning rather than default skill expansion.
GitHub mutation guard contracts remain CI-validated; native provider interception is deferred unless a controllable dispatcher surface becomes available.
Every live skill entrypoint has a consolidation classification and routing overlap clusters have machine-readable primary ownership rules.
Agent Engineering treats executor/model claims as candidate state and requires evidence-appropriate promotion into durable accepted state.
Tracing/evaluation, context engineering, controlled self-improvement, task-scoped tool authority, and delegation-authority contracts remain CI-validated.
Multi-agent delegation attenuates authority and does not silently expand tools, modes, resource scope, intent, credentials, confirmation state, or re-delegation permission.
Failure recovery now distinguishes retry, compensation, accepted partial completion, and escalation rather than treating every failure as automatic retry or rollback.
Retry of side-effecting work requires explicit evidence that repetition is idempotent or otherwise safe.
Compensation across external systems is semantic counter-action rather than atomic rollback; irreversible residual effects must remain disclosed.
Partial completion must record residual effects and blocked work, and failed compensation must escalate rather than being reported as recovered.
The current agent-refinement learning campaign is paused after v0.18.8; existing outcome checkpoints should accumulate naturally during ordinary work.
unresolved_risks: The public Core cannot intercept every native provider/tool/sub-agent call unless the host routes execution through an enforceable dispatcher or service ACL seam.
Eight skills remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE and should not be promoted to stronger consolidation decisions without representative outcomes.
Routing, verified-state, trajectory, context, self-improvement, authority, delegation, and recovery contracts remain contract-level refinements until representative real-task evidence accumulates.
Compensating actions may themselves be unavailable, lossy, or fail; external systems do not provide universal atomic rollback.
Idempotency and reversibility are action-specific and must not be inferred from tool availability alone.

next_executable_step.action: Pause proactive agent-refinement learning. Apply the existing contracts naturally during ordinary work, preserve genuine outcome evidence and regressions when they occur, and shift the next deliberate improvement campaign to a non-agent area selected with the Creator.
